verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing and accessing one-time passwords for two-step verification. Nothing in the evidence mentions Steam Guard codes, HOTP counter-based tokens, custom periods or custom digit lengths. Basic TOTP storage is an adjacent capability and does not show that non-standard tokens are supported.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
